title: Pocketwire Rewards Bonus and Courtesy Tariff
content:
This tariff fixes, for every Pocketwire Rewards tier, the quarterly milestone spend threshold and milestone bonus points, the anniversary bonus points, and the courtesy points amount for a late gift card fulfilment with its yearly limit.

## Quarterly milestone and anniversary

| Tier | Quarterly milestone spend threshold (USD of qualifying spend in one calendar quarter) | Milestone bonus points | Anniversary bonus points |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Rewards Member | 1000.00 | 500 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Silver | 2000.00 | 1000 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Gold | 3500.00 | 2000 | 500 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Platinum | 5000.00 | 3000 | 1000 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Diamond | 8000.00 | 5000 | 2500 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian | 15000.00 | 10000 | 5000 |

- The quarterly milestone spend threshold is the qualifying spend in one calendar quarter that earns the quarterly milestone bonus.
- The milestone bonus points are the points of the tier's quarterly milestone bonus.
- The anniversary bonus points are the tier's points for each membership anniversary while the membership is active. On Member and Silver the figure is 0.

## Courtesy points for late fulfilment

| Tier | Courtesy points amount per late fulfilment | Most courtesy credits over the rolling 365 days |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Rewards Member | 500 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Silver | 750 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Gold | 1000 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Platinum | 1500 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Diamond | 2500 | 3 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian | 5000 | 4 |

- The courtesy points amount is the tier's courtesy points for one late gift card fulfilment.
- The yearly limit is the most courtesy credits over the rolling 365 days.

## Reading the tariff

A Platinum membership has a quarterly milestone threshold of 5000.00 USD with milestone bonus points of 3000, and anniversary bonus points of 1000. A Silver membership has anniversary bonus points of 0.
